chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Masters the Yin-Yang Origin Sound in the Death World
chapter_meta_description: For three years, Xiao Chen battles skeleton kings to comprehend the second Origin Sound of Yin and Yang. He then enters a sovereign's domain and learns of the three battle emperors.
og_title: Yin and Yang: Xiao Chen's Death World Breakthrough
og_description: Xiao Chen's brutal cultivation of the second Origin Sound leads him to the domain of a female sovereign, where the three ancient skeleton kings are revealed as battle emperors.
twitter_title: Death World: Secret of Yin-Yang Origin Sound
twitter_description: After years of combat with skeleton kings, Xiao Chen masters the Yin-Yang Origin Sound and uncovers the fate of the three battle emperors.
